native_mechanisms: A glint leaves the source jewel and crawls along every cord at a pace proportional to that cord's length (weight = propagation delay, so arrival time = accumulated length)
Each jewel's square is chalked with the instant of its FIRST flare only; any later flare arriving along a longer/slacker cord is discarded and never re-marked (settle-once, no revision)
Squares that never catch a flare stay blank and are crossed out as unreachable, and are not pursued further
core_technique: Dijkstra SSSP with a CSR build and a size/density guard: plain O(n^2) array-scan Dijkstra for small or dense graphs, else sequential delta-stepping with distance-indexed buckets and a light/heavy edge partition (delta = mean edge weight)
